title: AGS vs The Golf Travel Agency: Honest Review
description: An objective comparison between domestic travel middlemen and Asia Golf Specialists' on-the-ground expat concierge service in Vietnam.

content:
Executive Summary

Should you book with a domestic agency in Australia, or directly with Aussie expats living on the ground in Southeast Asia?

When Australian golfers decide to book a premium trip to Southeast Asia, they face a critical logistical choice: use a traditional domestic travel agent based in Australia, or book directly with local specialists residing in the destination.

The Golf Travel Agency is a highly respected, Sydney-based domestic operator. They provide an excellent service for golfers looking to book trips across a wide variety of global destinations. Because they are based in Australia, they act as a reliable middleman, coordinating with third-party local guides and operators in the destination country to execute the tour.

Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) eliminates the middleman. We are Australian expats who permanently reside on the ground in Vietnam. We don't outsource your logistics to third-party local companies because we are the local company. By booking directly with expats who live, work, and play in Southeast Asia, you gain unparalleled "Local Guardian" access to un-googleable experiences, real-time crisis management, and the deepest local relationships.

Crisis Management: Direct WhatsApp access to your local expat host.

The Verdict: Which Should You Choose?

Choose The Golf Travel Agency If:

  • You are planning a trip to a non-Asian destination (like Barnbougle, Queenstown, or St Andrews).
  • You prefer walking into a physical office in Sydney to plan your trip.
  • You want to book flights, travel insurance, and golf all through one domestic broker.

Choose Asia Golf Specialists If:

  • You are traveling specifically to Vietnam, Thailand, or Cambodia and want hyper-specialized local expertise.
  • You prefer to cut out the middleman and book directly with the people executing your tour.
  • You want the security of having an Australian peer physically on the ground to manage logistics and steer you to the best local experiences.
